formation: Depicts a hand (爫) and a hand holding a weapon (攴) fighting with a tiger (虎). The component 攴 was later reanalyzed as 寸 (hand). Based on the original meaning "to fight a tiger". The current meaning is a phonetic loan.

components.note: 爫 is a component form of 爪.
Originally 攴, which depicts a hand holding a weapon. Later reanalyzed as 寸 (hand).
